description: Light amphibian of the type used for ice reconnaissance from Soviet polar ships, suspended in the main hall of the museum's converted single-faith church building on ulitsa Marata. No registration or construction number recorded. A Mi-4A marked CCCP-N963 was formerly shown here and russianplanes.net records it as gone. Free access on museum opening days. Position from russianplanes.net monument 4503.
museum_name: Russian State Museum of the Arctic and Antarctic
